title: Gold Miner
description: Swing a claw through a glittering cavern and haul up as much treasure as you can before time runs out.
instructions: Press New game. Press Space, Enter, the Drop claw button, or tap the mine to release the swinging claw. Gold and gems are valuable; heavy rocks take longer to pull up. Collect the biggest haul before the timer reaches zero.

achievements.title: First Find
achievements.description: Pull up your first piece of treasure.

achievements.title: Gold Rush
achievements.description: Earn 5,000 points across all completed rounds.
